task.goal: Compile the SEED-Reaction single-frame quote/stat collage format (bold caption bar over a branded three-photo composite) into a governed Builder harness so it can be produced repeatably without drifting from its native visual syntax.
task.success_condition: The exported definition preserves the format's native structure (caption bar, primary photo, two secondary insets, brand mark) and its wrong_reading_locks, and round-trips through category_binding.py without any fabricated semantic-lineage refs.
task.atomic_boundary: One ratified SuperVisuals reference set (this RCT-SEED-Reaction bundle) becomes one structural Builder contract for the caption-bar-plus-three-photo collage format. It does not cover carousels, multi-slide documentaries, or video variants of the same brand.

source_expression_moment.description: The specific real claim, moment, or photo set this instance of the format is built from (e.g. the underlying story behind the headline).

voice_context.description: Brand voice/tone parameters governing headline phrasing for this instance (house style, register, target platform).

structural_contract.description: Compiled structural definition of the caption-bar-plus-three-photo collage: bar copy block, primary image slot, two secondary image slots, brand mark slot.

activative_input.hidden_pressure: The scroller wants a fast, shareable jolt of identity-affirming insight without pausing to verify the underlying claim.
activative_input.stance: Declarative and celebratory, styled as a bold factual pronouncement.
stakes: dignity and consent of pictured individuals
accuracy of any stat or claim asserted
identity_urges: share proof of a positive narrative
activative_input.participation_design: Deliver one bold claim in the caption bar, ground it visually with a three-photo proof composite, and let the share/react action be the smallest unit of participation.
activative_input.intended_reaction: The viewer accepts the headline as a satisfying, affirming fact and shares or reacts within the first two seconds of exposure.
activative_input.smallest_useful_commitment: One tap to react or share.
wrong_reading_locks: Do not present an unverified or invented statistic (e.g. a precise percentage claim with no cited source) in the caption bar as if it were an established, scientifically validated fact — the bar's bold declarative typography must not be read as an editorial fact-check.

Do not pair a named real public figure's photo and biographical claim with unverifiable specifics (exact dollar figures, private family decisions) in a way that could be read as the platform's own verified investigative reporting rather than a circulated, unconfirmed claim.

Do not let an unrelated inset photo (e.g. a private, non-newsworthy couple or bystander) be read as depicting the literal subject or personal confirmation of the headline's claim — the two secondary insets are illustrative composite material, not evidence that the pictured individuals are the claim's source or endorsers.

Do not let the single specimen or single named example in the frame be read as a generalized, representative claim about an entire demographic group implied by the brand mark — one anecdote is not statistical coverage of the group.
Do not read the brand's circular logo placement as an implied certification, licensing, or partnership endorsement from the pictured individuals or their representatives.
